name: SEDIMENTATION SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-SDS-8 Sedimentation Shaker (Pipette Shaker) is utilized in environmental, soil testing, and pharmaceutical laboratories to guarantee uniform suspension of particles during sedimentation analysis, such as the Andreasen pipette method. It provides a slow, controlled rotation to prevent particle agglomeration without creating turbulent mixing.
features: Smooth 30° fixed tilt angle movement preventing turbulent mixing
Accommodates 5 or 6 samples in 50ml or 100ml cylinders
Consistent 40 Oscillations per Minute controlled by a speed regulator
Robust DC motor providing long years of trouble-free working
Lightweight, cost-effective painted/coated MS cabinet design

specifications.Optional Add-ons: Digital Timer 999 min, END cycle buzzer alarm
specifications.Target Applications: Soil Sedimentation analysis (Andreasen pipette method), Environmental testing
